name: personal-os
install: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && (command -v docker >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sudo sh) && (sudo dockerd --host=unix:///var/run/docker.sock --iptables=false >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 & sleep 2 || true) && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq postgresql postgresql-contrib >/dev/null && bun install
start: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && bash scripts/ensure-postgres.sh && cd packages/db && DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:password@127.0.0.1:5432/personal-os}" bun x drizzle-kit push --force
